scope: Pre-execution review of the single rank-validation correction made after the first 2004 official period export showed a gap in KOBIS source ranks. This addendum authorizes the newly pinned collector for the same raw-collection scope as the original execution review and changes no model, feature, evaluation, deployment, or publication authorization.

reviewed_change.removed_invalid_assumption: Do not recompute or require a continuous competition-rank sequence from row ordinal and annual admissions. The official 2004 export omits source rank 41 while the exported rows and official totals remain internally complete.
new_rank_contract: Parse each official source rank as a positive integer.
Require source ranks to be non-decreasing in export order.
Require annual admissions to be non-increasing in export order.
Preserve the official rank as a descriptive source value; never use it as row identity or as a completeness proof.
reviewed_change.row_identity_unchanged: source_row_id remains screening_year:ordinal, so rank gaps or ties cannot create collisions.
reviewed_change.screen_code_assignment_unchanged: A direct movie code is still attached only to the same first-100 export ordinal after exact rank, title, opening-date, annual-admissions, and cumulative-admissions equality.

retained_fail_closed_checks: Signed annual admissions and sales equality to each official total row
Complete period-versus-annual export multiset equality including duplicates and tail rows
Period screen total equality to full export row count
Exactly min(100,total) visible coded rows and exact same-ordinal five-field identity
Hash-checked raw checkpoints and fatal incomplete-cache handling
No training, scoring, service write, credentials, or non-reviewed endpoint
assessment: PASS. The former continuous competition-rank assertion was contradicted by a pinned official 2004 response and was not a valid completeness test. Treating rank as a positive non-decreasing source field while independently enforcing audience order, official signed totals, complete-export multiset equality, screen total, and same-ordinal code identity is stricter about the properties the collector actually relies on and permits no inferred rows or codes.
